messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — seeing a regression on canary after yesterday's chunking + prefetch change. Charts (heatmap/sparkline) stutter during initial render, ~300-500ms extra. Noticed parse/compile spikes in client telemetry and main bundle reported +120KB on canary.
Sam Patel: repro steps + link? can you dump the console perf trace?
Maria Chen: repro: open /metrics -> select 30d heatmap -> toggle series. Attaching a trimmed perf trace snippet below. Also canary link: https://canary-console.redwood.internal/metrics?canary=chunking-2026
Maria Chen: ```trace
LongTask x3 at 0x7f... \nParseHTML 120ms
CompileJS 210ms (main.js +120KB)

Stack: parse -> compile -> execute -> layout
```
Devon Ortiz: seeing a KV cache prefix miss spike in canary around the same time — could be our chunk mapping keys changing after the split. That increases cold fetches for charts that rely on cached prefetched chunks.
Jules: do we have webpack/next-bundle-stats for the canary build? curious if some chart vendor landed in main.
Kevin Li: I dug into the last PR (split-chunks: defer-prefetch=true). The change enabled aggressive idle prefetching for large chunks which looks like it moved a large vendor into a shared chunk that now gets parsed earlier. Quick grep: `chunksizeThreshold: 50kb` was lowered to `30kb`.
Sam Patel: options: 1) revert the prefetch tweak on canary 2) bump threshold back 50kb 3) switch to idle-only prefetch w/ backoff. Which is fastest to mitigate?
Maria Chen: I'd prefer a narrow rollback of the prefetch flag for charts first — less blast radius. If we still see +120KB then run bundle-analyzer and revert threshold.
Devon Ortiz: for an experiment we can stub prefetch for chart routes with this helper: `if (route.startsWith('/metrics')) skipPrefetch()` and measure. Also suggestion: use `requestIdleCallback(() => importChunk())` instead of immediate preload; prevents parse spikes during LCP.
Jules: +1 on analyzing bundle split map. Can we get a quick `next build --profile` artifact from canary pipeline?
Kevin Li: posted the build artifact link in the CI thread — looks like `recharts` ended up in shared-vendor~charts.js and gets prefetched early. That file is ~140kb gzipped before brotli.
Sam Patel: canary rollback scheduled?
deploy-bot: canary rollback job queued by Sam Patel at 1937654350 — starting now.
Maria Chen: I'll open an issue with steps, paste perf trace and CI artifact links, and add action items: (a) temporarily disable prefetch for /metrics (b) run bundle-analyzer and restore chunk threshold (c) add metric to telemetry for chunk parse time per-route. Assigning to eng-platform.
Kevin Li: quick patch to try: revert `deferPrefetch: true` and add `prefetchBackoff: 2000ms` on chart chunks. I'll PR.
Sam Patel: after rollback, let's run A/B where canary A has no prefetch and B has idle-prefetch. Measure mean chart render 95p.
Maria Chen: thanks — TL;DR: regression likely from aggressive prefetch + lowered chunk threshold, mitigation = disable prefetch on chart routes, run analyzer, then iterate with idle-prefetch/backoff. I'll update the issue when rollback finishes. :thumbsup:
